Attack Shark X11SE Wireless Gaming Mouse Black (Tri-Mode 2.4GHz / Bluetooth / Wired / PAW3311 Optical Sensor / 22000 DPI / RGB Magnetic Charging Dock / 1-Year Store Warranty)

Elevate your competitive gameplay with the Attack Shark X11SE Wireless Gaming Mouse in Black, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year store warranty. Featuring an ultra-lightweight design, high-precision PixArt PAW3311 optical sensor supporting up to 22,000 DPI, and flexible tri-mode connectivity (2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.2, and Type-C wired), this mouse delivers unmatched tracking accuracy and speed. Complete with an RGB magnetic charging dock, it ensures your mouse is always powered up and ready for high-stakes gaming sessions.
